notes: The page defines P^m(X) as the kernel of the displayed composite through the blow-up and hyperplane family, and then states a Griffiths homomorphism into H^1(S,R^{m-1}f_*(Q_chi)). This is a reading of its claim, not a verification of the construction.

The triangle Y -> X_S over S induces the displayed i* map. The following assertion says that the inverse image of Im i* under the Griffiths homomorphism is reduced to zero. It is followed by the author’s statement: Ceci se fait par des calculs explicites essentiellement triviaux, compte tenu de la structure cohomologique connue d’une variété éclatée. No such calculation is supplied on this page.

Section 5 combines the cited 3) and 4), inserts supposant m=2n, and assumes the generic hyperplane immersion satisfies a) and b) of 2). It asserts that algebraic triviality of the restriction of z entails cohomological triviality modulo torsion. The referenced conditions and constructions are not available within this page-only reading.

The final paragraph describes a quotient called groupe de Griffiths, tensors it with underlined Q, and claims it contains the algebraic primitive cohomology subspace. The sentence ends mid-phrase with - vectoriel qui a. No noun or continuation is supplied.

Mathematical diagnostic: a generic point ordinarily has a different role from a chosen geometric point, so H’s added prose overbar required inspection. The ink has no detached bar at that prose cell, but has a t-like overprint component; the correction order remains uncertain.

Mathematical diagnostic: the tensor-looking symbol contains a recoverable lowercase typed x, so the modern tensor glyph was not accepted as a literal source-layer description. Its oval remains typed-O/pen-circle uncertain.

The page itself supplies no expressed mathematical reservation beyond its modal parenthesis en fait, on y pourrait remplacer S par P^1_k, mais ... peu importe ici and the explicit cancelled revisions. The word triviaux is an authorial assessment, not an independently established check.
The masculine équivalent after restriction, the cancelled On, and the incomplete final vectoriel phrase are retained literally. They are not repaired by grammar or expected mathematics.
No mathematical proof, re-proof, computation or imported background theorem was checked in this reading. Only formula parsing and source consistency were used as diagnostics; check_events is empty.
